title: dendrosenecio cheranganiensis
intro: Dendrosenecio cheranganiensis, commonly known as Cherangani senecio, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine in Kenya, where it is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Studies have shown that Dendrosenecio cheranganiensis contains bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, which have been found to have therapeutic actions including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiproliferative effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential uses of this plant.
